source_of_truth: Versions resolved by Cloud Build b1230b1b (GCP image chemflow2-byol). Every device that produces numbers for the papers must match this file; check with: python3 tools/toolchain/check_toolchain.py --orca /ABS/PATH/orca

orca.licence: ORCA is free for academic use but may not be redistributed. Each user downloads it from https://orcaforum.kofo.mpg.de after registering; never commit the installer or the binaries to git.

other.rule: macOS / other builds: download the ORCA 6.1.0 build for that platform; the binary hash differs per platform, so only the version (6.1.0) and a working 2-process MPI job are enforced. check_toolchain.py records the binary sha256 in the device receipt.
